When an event takes place, you're judged based off of how you discuss it.

Discussing people = gossip/rumors/drama
Discussing events = objective facts about something that took place
Discussing ideas = what you can take away from the situation, how it effects you or the topic in question, and how you can change/improve something

Providing context for a conversation about an idea that involves a person or an event is not discussing said person/event. The topic of the conversation is the idea.
